messages:
priya: Quick sync — ACME mobile is requesting p95 < 150ms for chat replies to go GA. They insist on low latency even at low concurrency. We need to RICE this infra work and define launch criteria. Options on table: (1) dedicated low-latency pool, (2) hybrid routing (hot path -> small models/dedicated, cold path -> larger models/shared), (3) aggressive quantization + batching. Thoughts? React with :one: :two: :three: for preference.

sam: +1 to hybrid routing. Preserves cost:latency tradeoffs. But needs routing policy infra and tracing to validate fallbacks.

matt: Hybrid seems highest impact for ACME. Effort: medium-high because of routing + metrics. RICE: Reach=high, Impact=high, Confidence=medium, Effort=high. Score looks favorable compared to full dedicated which is high effort/cost.

elaine: Also consider user distribution — 70% low-seq mobile where p95 matters, 30% desktop batch. That strengthens hybrid case. We should add a canary condition: route <5% traffic to dedicated during rollout.

priya: Good point. Proposed launch criteria: p95 < 150ms on canary for 2 days, error rate delta < 0.1%, cost per 1k reqs within +20% of baseline. Also add rollback if quality metrics degrade.

sam: Implementation sketch:
```
route(request) {
  if (request.seq_len < 128 && user_tier == 'mobile-hot') -> lowlatency_pool
  else -> standard_pool
}
```
Need metadata propagation & KV cache warmup hooks.

matt: Will require batching guardrails in lowlatency_pool to keep latency SLO. Might need micro-batching disabled and per-request concurrency cap.

priya: Quick RICE poll results so we can present to GTM: react counts: :one: 8, :two: 21, :three: 5. Hybrid routing wins. Next: estimate effort — engineering please drop ETA by EOD.

sam: ETA = 3 sprints to get alpha with metric plumbing + canary. Includes infra work + small runtime hooks.

elaine: I'll prepare the metric dashboard: p50/p95/p99 latency, cost per 1k, model-quality drift. Will add evaluation prompt set for ACME.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled for canary on 1977-05-15T09:00Z once metrics ready.

priya: Thanks all. I'll add this to the roadmap with the launch criteria above and RICE notes. We'll reconvene after effort estimates.
